text: First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
author: Epictetus
visual_brief: An industrial design sketch with confident perspective linework and construction lines showing a heavy mechanical ratchet and pawl mechanism mid-stroke. Curved motion arrows indicate the irreversible forward rotation of the toothed gear wheel as the lever drives it ahead.
alt: Industrial sketch of a mechanical ratchet wheel advancing forward on its axle.
